volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

rate.tooltip: Clock rate in Hz. Wired ƒ cancels Rate (absolute Hz), same as oscillators.

pulseStart.tooltip: Where in the cycle the gate goes high. Quantized to whole samples.

pulseEnd.tooltip: Where in the cycle the gate goes low. Quantized to whole samples.

density.tooltip: Pulse density (impulse rate per second). Higher density = smoother, denser reflections/noise.

tapCount.tooltip: Number of sparse taps in Diffuser mode. Tap Count / Density sets tail length.

darkness.tooltip: Maximum randomized rectangular pulse width in Diffuser mode. 1 = bright velvet noise; higher values = wider rectangular pulses for natural 6 dB/oct high-frequency damping.

tailDarkness.tooltip: Darkness at the end of the Diffuser tail. The widest pulse grows from Darkness at the first tap to this at the last, so the tail gets darker as it goes, like a room where the highs die first. The tail's level stays set by Decay; this only changes its colour. 0 = off (the whole tail uses Darkness).

stereoSpread.tooltip: 0% = identical L/R tap offsets (mono). 100% = independent L/R taps for decorrelated stereo.

seed.tooltip: RNG seed for impulse positions, signs, and pulse widths. Same seed = identical sequence.

decay.tooltip: Diffuser tail decay rate: tap level falls by this many dB every second, like a reverb tail (60 dB/s = a 1 s T60). 0 = flat; small values are almost flat. The tail length is still Tap Count / Density, so raise Tap Count or lower Density for a longer tail.

mix.tooltip: Dry/wet mix in Diffuser mode (0% = dry input, 100% = wet). Output level in Generator mode.
